Tony Bettenhausen - Miller High Life Trophy
Since 1961, the Miller Brewing Co. of Milwaukee has awarded a trophy to the outstanding driver picked
by a committee of newspapermen and auto racing officials for the speedway car and late model stock car races
that are held here. The driver to receive the speedway car award will be picked after today's race. The stock
car driver judged as outstanding for the four races here this year will be picked after the 250 mile race on
Sunday, September 8.
The big car award winners include: 1961 - Len Sutton; 1962 - Rodger Ward; 1963 - A. J. Foyt; 1964 - Bud
Tinglestad; 1965 - Joe Leonard; 1966 - Mario Andretti; and 1967 - Gordon Johncock.
Stock Car winners include: 1961 - Dick Rathmann; 1962 - Don White; 1963 and 1964 - Parnelli Jones;
1965 - Jim Hurtubise; 1966 - Don White; and 1967 - Jack Bowsher.

Inner Workings Of The Turbine Car Are Revealed
260
Armin Krueger and STP Photos
When Joe Leonard of San Jose, Calif., set a new qualifying mark for the 1968 Indianapolis 500 miler
and then led the race, the quiet STP Turbine fired the imagination of racing buffs, everywhere. Milwaukee race
fans got a look at the cars when Leonard and Art Pollard of Medford, Ore., qualified for the June 9 150 mile
Rex Mays race. Leonard is seen in the top photo on his time trial run.
In the above four smaller photos, the various features of the Turbines are graphically shown. Upper left:
Front suspension showing inboard disc brakes with bottom-mounted lobster housing for pucks. Upper right:
Detail of rear assembly, including oil radiator tanks. Note exhaust stack rising behind roll bar. Lower left:
Cockpit with fire extinguisher placed in slot under driver's knees. Feet go fully into the nose of the monocoque
area. Lower right: Looking astern from cockpit into Morse chain case at forward end of turbine engine, just
behind the roll bar with the exhaust stack behind the driver's head.
